# m.reference.market_status

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Whether the markets are open now, by exchange, currency market, and index group.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.reference.market_status(*, on_error=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows
- `poll(interval, mode=dm.PollMode.APPEND)`: appends each new state of a row, identified by `ServerTime`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `AfterHours` | Boolean | Whether or not the market is in post-market hours. |
| `CurrenciesCrypto` | String | The status of the crypto market. From the `currencies` object: Contains the status of various currency markets. |
| `CurrenciesFx` | String | The status of the forex market. From the `currencies` object: Contains the status of various currency markets. |
| `EarlyHours` | Boolean | Whether or not the market is in pre-market hours. |
| `ExchangesNasdaq` | String | The status of the Nasdaq market. From the `exchanges` object: Contains the status of different US stock exchanges (e.g., Nasdaq, NYSE). |
| `ExchangesNyse` | String | The status of the NYSE market. From the `exchanges` object: Contains the status of different US stock exchanges (e.g., Nasdaq, NYSE). |
| `ExchangesOtc` | String | The status of the OTC market. From the `exchanges` object: Contains the status of different US stock exchanges (e.g., Nasdaq, NYSE). |
| `IndicesGroupsCccy` | String | The status of Cboe Streaming Market Indices Cryptocurrency ("CCCY") indices trading hours. From the `indicesGroups` object: Contains the status of various index groups (e.g., MSCI, FTSE Russell). |
| `IndicesGroupsCgi` | String | The status of Cboe Global Indices ("CGI") trading hours. From the `indicesGroups` object: Contains the status of various index groups (e.g., MSCI, FTSE Russell). |
| `IndicesGroupsDowJones` | String | The status of Dow Jones indices trading hours. From the `indicesGroups` object: Contains the status of various index groups (e.g., MSCI, FTSE Russell). |
| `IndicesGroupsFtseRussell` | String | The status of Financial Times Stock Exchange Group ("FTSE") Russell indices trading hours. From the `indicesGroups` object: Contains the status of various index groups (e.g., MSCI, FTSE Russell). |
| `IndicesGroupsMsci` | String | The status of Morgan Stanley Capital International ("MSCI") indices trading hours. From the `indicesGroups` object: Contains the status of various index groups (e.g., MSCI, FTSE Russell). |
| `IndicesGroupsMstar` | String | The status of Morningstar ("MSTAR") indices trading hours. From the `indicesGroups` object: Contains the status of various index groups (e.g., MSCI, FTSE Russell). |
| `IndicesGroupsMstarc` | String | The status of Morningstar Customer ("MSTARC") indices trading hours. From the `indicesGroups` object: Contains the status of various index groups (e.g., MSCI, FTSE Russell). |
| `IndicesGroupsNasdaq` | String | The status of National Association of Securities Dealers Automated Quotations ("Nasdaq") indices trading hours. From the `indicesGroups` object: Contains the status of various index groups (e.g., MSCI, FTSE Russell). |
| `IndicesGroupsSAndP` | String | The status of Standard & Poor's ("S&P") indices trading hours. From the `indicesGroups` object: Contains the status of various index groups (e.g., MSCI, FTSE Russell). |
| `IndicesGroupsSocieteGenerale` | String | The status of Societe Generale indices trading hours. From the `indicesGroups` object: Contains the status of various index groups (e.g., MSCI, FTSE Russell). |
| `Market` | String | The status of the market as a whole. |
| `Overnight` | Boolean | Whether or not the market is in overnight hours (9:00 PM to 4:00 AM ET). |
| `ServerTime` | Instant | The current time of the server, returned as a date-time in RFC3339 format. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
